I had two sessions a year ago (Dec 2024) for my shoulder and can now play a full round of golf. A 25% improvement would have been good and only dared hope for 50% but now would put it at 75%. Previously I had to stop playing for 5 months hoping it would heal by itself. It took a couple of months after the injections to improve and but continued improving for 6 months. I had a historic motorbike crash landing heavily on my shoulder so do not expect a complete cure.

4 months after receiving 3 sessions of PRP shoulder injections for rotary cuff tear, I am virtually pain free. I feel so much better after 2 years of continuous pain. At first I was skeptical about this procedure, but after doing some research I decided to give it a try. Thank you Surecell.

How Dr Patrick saved my life
Dear Sir / Madam
I am a patient of Mrs Gay at the rehabilitations centre. She is fantastic at her job and has really helped me .
I have a trapped sciatic nerve which she has been treating.
Dr Patrick suggested I have a neck and spine X-ray , which I went and had done. Unbelievably , Dr Patrick noticed something on my X-ray and asked me to go and arrange to have a heart checkup .
I already have a full heath check annually at a hospital . So regardless , I called Bangkok Bangkok hospital in Bangkok and arranged to go and see a specialist to get further tests .
They found most of my arteries were blocked with calcium,  my right leg was 85% blocked and around my heart was also not so good . The specialist said , thank god Dr Patrick noticed this , or at the most ,6 months you would have had a massive heart attack .
I have had 4 stents fitted around my heart , then next week I will go back in for my leg .
Dr Patrick , I would like to thank you , you really saved my life.
You deserve a medal
Regards
Martin Holmes
